about: Models the llama.cpp setup suggests (UX-057). Read by coworker/providers/llamacpp_setup.py. Each names a Hugging Face repo and the GGUF files OpenWorker downloads into llama.cpp's own cache; `draft` is a second file for speculative decoding (`spec_type`). `size` is the bytes of all files, for the fit advice; a model too large for the machine is not offered. `ollama` is the same model's name in Ollama, for the download command shown next to it. `license` and `license_url` are shown before Download, read from the model card on Hugging Face (`license_source` says where; checked 2026-10-26). Edit in git; give a source.
